اغلولبت (form XII)

# اِغْلَوْلَبْتِ (iḡlawlabti) /iɣ.law.lab.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِغْلَوْلَبَ (iḡlawlaba)
# اِغْلَوْلَبَتْ (iḡlawlabat) /iɣ
